1. Update

Legend Mode

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44892218/34dde6d2a5e4877d3518c0b0ced30140af5d7cb0.jpg

This fantastically named mode allows you to experience the powerful voices of the past, letting various magical girls test their magic against each other.

Currently, it includes voices from the magical administrative girls of the Grand Magical Bureau and the magical development girls from the development team, with more voices to be added in the future!


Notification Feature Added

We are adding a notification feature for pre-announcing maintenance to ensure a more comfortable magic casting environment. From now on, you will receive magical in-game notices in advance of any scheduled maintenance.


UI Improvements

We have improved various elements of the magical duel screen. After selecting the duel location, it will now clearly show which location has been chosen. Additionally, the timing of animations during magical duel interactions has been adjusted.



2. Maintenance Notice

To update the game, we need to purify the server's malice, so we are announcing the maintenance schedule as follows: Date: July 24th, 2024, from 7:00 PM for approximately 1.5 hour (subject to slight changes based on purification work).

During this time, access to the game will be unavailable. .•°(° ＞⌓＜°)°•.


We have many improvements planned to make your magical girl experience even more enjoyable, so please stay tuned!

ദ്ദി・ᴗ・)✧

Thank you, magical girls!

notes.title: 5/30 Magic Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Magic Development Girl~ 🌟✨

Additional Patch Notice: we have commenced server patch for 15 mins starting from 10 PM to improve spell recognition.


With the help of many magical girls, we found and purified the malice hidden within the game! 🔮

We have especially added the following features to make it easier to set up the magic wand (microphone) and the oath! 🎤💫

1. Added a feature to retry the oath in the options (Re-calibrate)! 🌈

If you do the oath too passionately and strongly, the game might become difficult! 😅
For those who have already done the oath strongly or changed the magic wand during the game, try doing the oath again in a gentle robot voice~ 🤖

2. Added a visual indicator to check the operation of the selected magic wand (microphone) in the option menu! 👀

After selecting the correct magic wand, please check if it is working properly! 🎙️
If the magic wand works even when you're not speaking, turn off the sound effects in use or connect a separate magic wand directly to the PC! 🧙‍♀️

3. Added a feature to check the microphone setting guide or return to the title screen from the oath screen! 📜

If the oath is not going well, we've added a button to connect to the microphone setting guide! 💡
To reduce the inconvenience of having to restart the game to reset the microphone, we've added a button to return to the title screen from the oath screen! 🎮

We have also added the following quality of life features! 🎁

Added options, return to title, and resume battle functions during episode play! 🚀
Added a feature to hide the battle code during online magic duels! 🔒
Improved the spell recognition function to better recognize the spells of magical girls with higher voices! 🎶
Corrected typos in some dialogues! ✏️
Fixed the issue where Paul's shoulder looked unnatural due to being cut off! 👕

All magical girls, thank you and please enjoy your adventures as magical girls! 🌟💕
